description:
Term Insurance is the type of life insurance in which if death occurs during the policy tenure, then his or her nominee will receive the sum assured.

 If the insured survives till the end of the policy period, then he or she will not get any maturity amount. 
These policies have low premiums and cover the large risk.

In this video, we have discussed Top 5 Term Insurance Plans, features, ratios as well as calculated their premiums.
